statement_summary: Documented security program covering all four entities
Owner designated in writing as security lead for each entity
Annual SP 800-30 risk assessment plus change triggers (new business, system, AI feature, hire)
Risk decision rules; High risks never accepted as they are
Annual evaluation with outside review every second year
Annual policy review
Sanctions for LLC employees
Written, time-limited exceptions
No written terms, no Restricted data; 10-day breach notice in contractor terms
Vendor list with data held and security notice contact
Vendor checklist before buying a tool that holds Restricted data
Exit step when a vendor relationship ends
Annual review of the accounting service SOC 2 report and customer controls
Owner-started, watched remote support
Own accounts and PINs; no shared passwords
App-based MFA everywhere; hardware key for email and banking
Unique passphrases in a password manager; default passwords changed
Hire and departure checklist; quarterly account review
Least privilege: bookkeeper role; separate administrator account
Device lock after 5 minutes (phones and tablets 1 minute)
Monthly review of sign-ins, forwarding rules, users, gate entries, payee changes, and bank alerts
Sealed emergency access sheet, recovery codes, and spare key with the business attorney
Three-level classification
Restricted data only in approved locations; each LLC's data kept separate
Full-disk encryption and individual sign-in on every computer
Restricted data sent only through its system or encrypted links
Rental applications and screening reports stay in the platform
Backup service for suite; monthly exports; annual restore test
Retention and disposal schedule with a deletion record
Security records kept at least 5 years
Automatic updates, antivirus, standard accounts for staff
Customer Wi-Fi on a separate guest network
regulatory_driver: CSF 2.0 portfolio profile PR.IR-01 (voluntary); card processor terms (contract)

statement_summary: Callback before any new or changed payee; only the owner changes payees
AI tools: approved tool only; no Restricted data; no decisions about people
Written tenant selection criteria; adverse action notices
Annual training for the owner and staff; payment fraud briefing
Runbook with printed contacts; call-the-owner notice at each site
Anyone reports a suspected incident the same day; incident log with discovery time
Record which LLC's data was involved and the same-day agent notice to that LLC
Per-LLC notice deadlines; written no-harm determinations
No ransom or extortion payment without counsel and an OFAC check
Annual walkthrough; lessons learned within 30 days
Storage manager's written authority for up to two weeks
